body:
## Pull request overview

This PR upstreams core functionality from the downstream `@objectql/core` package into `@objectstack/objectql` to consolidate the codebase and enable deprecation of the downstream package. The migration includes introspection types, utility functions, and a kernel factory while maintaining backward compatibility.

**Changes:**
- Adds database introspection types and utilities for converting existing schemas to ObjectStack metadata
- Adds `createObjectQLKernel()` factory function for simplified kernel initialization
- Includes comprehensive documentation (README updates, migration guide) and test coverage (22 tests)

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/objectql/src/util.ts | New file adding introspection types (IntrospectedSchema, IntrospectedTable, IntrospectedColumn, IntrospectedForeignKey) and utility functions (toTitleCase, convertIntrospectedSchemaToObjects, mapDatabaseTypeToFieldType) |
| packages/objectql/src/util.test.ts | New test file with 22 comprehensive tests covering all utility functions and database type mappings |
| packages/objectql/src/kernel-factory.ts | New file adding createObjectQLKernel async factory function with ObjectQLKernelOptions interface |
| packages/objectql/src/index.ts | Updated exports to include new kernel factory, utilities, and introspection types |
| packages/objectql/README.md | Enhanced with usage examples, exported components table, introspection types table, and migration summary |
| content/docs/guides/objectql-migration.mdx | New comprehensive migration guide with step-by-step instructions for migrating from @objectql/core |
| content/docs/guides/meta.json | Registered objectql-migration guide in navigation |
| .changeset/upgrade-objectql-core.md | Changeset documenting minor version bump for new features |
</details>
